items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Alfred Woodard, he played trumpet. And was there in Banister... In fact, just about in the whole band.

ctx.x: That was good. Warren Miles, he played piano. I played piano myself too. Alfred Woodard, he played trumpet. And was there in Banister, he played guitar. And Edgar Miles, he played trombone. Well, we made different changes from time to time.
You don't remember who played drums?
